:::{#exm-dot-product-matmul}
#### Dot product as matrix multiplication

The dot product of two column vectors $\vx$ and $\vb$
can be written as a matrix product of the row vector $\tp{\vx}$
with the column vector $\vb$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\vx \cdot \vb
&= \tp{\vx}\, \vb
\\ &= [x_1,\; x_2,\; \ldots,\; x_p]
\begin{bmatrix}
\beta_{1} \\
\beta_{2} \\
\vdots \\
\beta_{p}
\end{bmatrix}
\\ &=
x_1\beta_1 + x_2\beta_2 + \cdots + x_p \beta_p
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
